summary: An enemy army surrounded the city where Elisha was staying. His servant was terrified, but Elisha prayed, and God opened the servant's eyes to see the hills full of horses and chariots of fire. Sabbath Camp looks back at Elisha's story.

story_reel.narration: Welcome to Sabbath Camp! The king of Aram was at war with Israel. But every time he made a secret plan, God told Elisha, and Elisha warned the king of Israel. The king of Aram was furious. 'Who is the spy?' His officers said, 'It's Elisha the prophet. He tells the king of Israel the words you speak in your bedroom!' So the king sent a huge army with horses and chariots to the town of Dothan to capture Elisha. They surrounded the city at night. Early the next morning, Elisha's servant went outside and saw the enemy army everywhere! He ran to Elisha. 'Oh no, master! What should we do?' Elisha calmly said, 'Don't be afraid. Those who are with us are more than those who are with them.' Then Elisha prayed, 'Yahweh, please open his eyes so he can see.' And God opened the servant's eyes. He looked up and saw the hills all around full of horses and chariots of fire, God's angel army, surrounding Elisha! Then God made the enemy soldiers confused, and Elisha led them right into Israel's capital. Instead of fighting them, Elisha said, 'Give them food and water, and send them home.' They feasted, and the raids stopped for a long time. Let's remember: Elisha followed faithfully, the widow's oil overflowed, a rooftop room held a miracle, Naaman was healed, and an axe head floated. This week's big truth: you can stay faithful because Yahweh is always with you.
